description: Defines the BaseViewModel class for handling UI interactions in the Notesnook project, including list management, sorting, and group finding.

classes.name: BaseViewModel
classes.description: A class providing methods to interact with list views in the Notesnook web application, including sorting, focusing, and waiting for elements.

methods.name: findGroup
methods.description: Finds a group header element by name within the list.

methods.name: iterateItems
methods.description: Asynchronously iterates over list items, yielding each item locator.

methods.name: waitForItem
methods.description: Waits until a list item with the specified title appears.

methods.name: waitForList
methods.description: Waits for the list to be loaded, either by placeholder or full list.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focuses on the first list item by clicking it twice.

methods.name: press
methods.description: Simulates pressing a key on the list.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Performs sorting actions based on provided options, interacting with context menu.

methods.name: items
methods.description: Getter that returns the locator for list items.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the list is empty.
